title: The Effects of Tip Recommendations on Customer Tipping, Satisfaction, Repatronage, and Spending
authors: Damon Alexander; Christopher Boone; Michael Lynn
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment: customers of an app-based laundry service randomly assigned to tip-recommendation conditions; outcomes compared across conditions with OLS/logit on i.suggestion_condition_real (clustered by customer). No pre/post adoption timing, no unit and time FE.
design_notes: run_analysis.do: reg/logit outcome on i.suggestion_condition_real or ask_amount (continuous recommended amount) with interactions; Table 3 compares pretreatment means. The only 'difference-in-difference' in the text cites Hoover (2019) on NYC taxis, not this paper's design.
data_files_note: Raw company data (tips_fix.csv, 94,571 orders) and analysis files shipped.
data_provenance_note: Raw company export plus ACS zip-code income.
screener_notes: Published PDF text read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2019.3541.txt). Management Science 2021, 67(1).
